physical_hip_height_adapter.policy: Evaluated mean anatomical hip height; preserves each target paw-pivot-to-floor offset.

dense_recovery_hold.policy: The actual final constrained dense pose is held; do not jump back to the separately solved coarse pose.

tail_region_revision.policy: Remove reviewed actual tail vertices from physical paw patches; rebase supported center targets to the same physical soles.

temporal_seed.method: minimum squared third difference; neutral and final held pose fixed

binding.limb_policy: Physical upper/elbow/wrist/paw and hip/stifle/hock/paw directions in rest-cancelled torso frames. Hind source labels corrected without changing source payload.

anatomical_trajectory_fit.endpoint_policy: Original neutral and recovered hold preserved; native source-directed launch with unchanged bite time.

coupled_anatomical_contact_projection.policy: Small coupled native correction, physical segment branch retained; held from the same settled event.

native_muzzle_fit.policy: Actor-specific physical muzzle trajectory rebased after final torso/limb adaptation, evaluated from the exact native export. Original seed guide retained separately; source category features remain unchanged.
